examples.title: Peek at the first 4 KiB of a large log

description: Read ONE entry without extracting the archive, by `name` (exact; the last duplicate wins) or `index` (central-directory position — disambiguates duplicates). mode 'data' (default): decompressed content as base64 or UTF-8 `text` (encoding:'utf8'; ENTRY_NOT_UTF8 otherwise), CRC-verified; a `range` {offset,length} reads a byte window through the chunked stream (bounded memory, no CRC). mode 'raw': the compressed payload verbatim (feed it to inflate_raw). mode 'verify': CRC / size / local-header agreement only. Inline cap 16 MiB per entry (ENTRY_TOO_LARGE → use a range or extract_zip file mode). Encrypted entries → ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_ENCRYPTION (no decryption in this engine).

access.description: 'auto' (default): in memory, and a zipPath above 1073741824 bytes by byte ranges. 'range': always by byte ranges over the sandbox file (never a URL; memory ≈ the central directory). 'memory': always buffered (INPUT_TOO_LARGE above the cap).

encoding.description: Content encoding for mode 'data': base64 (default) or UTF-8 text (invalid UTF-8 → ENTRY_NOT_UTF8).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep, after verbosity (e.g. ['entryCount', 'entries.name']); unmatched ones are listed in _meta.unmatchedFields.

includeExtendedTimestamps.description: Add the entry's `extendedTimestamps` (zipnative getExtendedTimestamps: UT, then NTFS, then the DOS fields; ISO-8601, UTC).

includeUnixIds.description: Add the entry's `unixIds` (zipnative getUnixIds: the Info-ZIP ux uid / gid, or null).

index.description: Central-directory position (from list_zip_entries) — disambiguates duplicate names. Exclusive with name.

limits.description: Per-call override of zipnative's security bounds (CWE-400/409); absent keys keep the engine defaults (describe_engine.defaultLimits). A value above its operator ceiling is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise only for trusted input.

maxEntryCompressedSize.description: Bytes, one compressed payload fetched by the byte-range reader (access range).

mode.description: 'data' (default): decompressed content; 'raw': the compressed payload bytes verbatim (zero-copy, no decompression); 'verify': CRC / size / local-header check only, no payload.

name.description: Entry name (exact, case-sensitive; the LAST duplicate wins). Exclusive with index.

range.description: Read only a byte window of the decompressed content through the chunked stream (bounded memory; CRC is not verified for a window). length ≤ 16777216.

length.description: Window length in bytes; fewer are returned at the end of the entry (`range.returned`).

offset.description: First byte of the window (0-based, in the decompressed content).

strict.description: Turn the first engine diagnostic into a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error.

verbosity.description: 'summary': scalar verdict fields only (the token-frugal form).

verifyCrc.description: Verify the decompressed CRC-32 against the central directory (mode data, no range).

zipBase64.description: Archive bytes, base64 (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with zipPath.

zipPath.description: Archive path relative to the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (container extensions: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64; saves re-sending bytes between calls.

name: read_zip_entry

outputSchema.description: One entry's content or verification. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

access.description: Present when the archive was read by byte ranges (access 'range', or a zipPath above the in-memory cap).

diagnosticCount.description: summary only: number of distinct diagnostics.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal engine concerns (de-duplicated by code + entry, ≤ 200; codes in describe_engine.diagnosticCodes). Empty for a clean archive.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when rows beyond 200 were dropped.

crc32.description: CRC-32 of the uncompressed data, 8 lowercase hex digits.

extendedTimestamps.description: With includeExtendedTimestamps: modification / access / creation instants (ISO-8601, UTC) from the UT (0x5455) extra, else the NTFS (0x000a) extra, else the DOS fields (source names which); a missing one is null.

index.description: Position in the central directory (or in the forward scan).

isSymlink.description: Unix mode S_IFLNK; null from a forward scan.

lastModified.description: ISO-8601 (DOS time has 2-second granularity; UT extra refines it).

sanitizedPath.description: The relative path a secure extraction would use; null when the name cannot be made safe (traversal, absolute, drive/UNC, NUL, ADS, device name).

unixIds.description: With includeUnixIds: the Unix owner uid / gid from the Info-ZIP ux (0x7875) extra; null when the archive carries none.

unixMode.description: Octal permission bits when Unix-authored ('0644'), else null.

sizeBytes.description: Bytes returned (data / raw) or the declared uncompressed size (verify).

localHeaderMatch.description: The local header agrees with the central directory — cross-checked for every entry, encrypted ones included (zipnative 1.1.0).

skipped.description: Why the payload was not verified; absent when it was.

title: Read one entry (random access)
